list.title: Templates
list.name: Name
list.emptyHint: Write it once. Send it whenever.
list.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. Broadcasts that started from it keep their copy.
list.htmlChipHint: Written in HTML; opens in code mode

html.banner: Written in HTML. The block editor can't edit this layout faithfully, so it opens in code mode.
html.textDerived: Plain text: generated from the HTML.
html.convertBody: The layout will be flattened into the block editor's model: tables, inline CSS and anything the blocks can't express are lost. The stored HTML only changes when you save.
html.switchBody: The blocks are replaced by the HTML they render, and the template opens in code mode from then on. Blocks with a Show if condition are left out of that HTML. Until you save, Back to blocks undoes the switch; after that, converting back flattens the layout.
html.backBody: Your HTML edits will be discarded, and the blocks come back as they were before the switch.

editor.nameHint: Internal label. Recipients never see it.
editor.hiddenBySupportView: Template content is hidden in support view.

picker.label: Start from a template
picker.hint: Copies its content here. Later template edits change nothing.
picker.replaceBody: Applying this template overwrites the current body and subject.
